items.question: Which courts have jurisdiction over disputes under the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement specifies that the courts of London have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes arising from the agreement. This is stated in the document titled "Northbridge NDA" under clause 8.2 [1].

There is no mention of any other court having jurisdiction in the sources provided.

Other documents, such as the Northbridge NDA and the Harrowgate MSA, mention governing laws, but they are separate agreements. The Unit 7 Lease also mentions governing law, but it is unrelated to the Calder & Wynne engagement.

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

items.question: What interest accrues on late rent under the warehouse lease?

items.question: How much notice of non-renewal must be given under the MSA?
items.answer: The MSA requires ninety (90) days' written notice of non-renewal after the Initial Term. The relevant text states: "unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term" [1].

evidence.quote: unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term

items.question: How often does Harrowgate invoice, and is it in advance or in arrears?
items.answer:
Harrowgate invoices monthly in advance. The relevant source states, "Provider shall invoice monthly in advance. Invoices are payable net thirty (30) days from the invoice date" [1].

There is no indication that Harrowgate invoices in arrears. The documents do not mention any other invoicing frequency or method.

evidence.quote: Provider shall invoice monthly in advance. Invoices are payable net thirty (30) days from the invoice date

items.question: What makes information Confidential Information under the Northbridge NDA?
items.answer: Under the Northbridge NDA, Confidential Information includes all information disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential [1].

evidence.quote: Confidential Information means all information disclosed by a Party (the 'Discloser') to the other (the 'Recipient') in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential.

items.question: When is the warehouse rent suspended?
items.answer: The warehouse rent is suspended if the Premises are unfit for use for more than thirty (30) consecutive days because of an event beyond a party's reasonable control [1].
